title: OKX launches X-Perps, MiFID-regulated crypto derivatives in Europe
summary: OKX has launched X-Perps in Europe under MiFID rules, which offer five-year expiry crypto derivatives with up to 10x leverage across BTC, ETH and other tokens.

title: eToro to acquire Zengo in self-custody push as CEO predicts $250K Bitcoin
summary: eToro is set to acquire self-custodial wallet provider Zengo, and the trading platform’s CEO predicted a Bitcoin rally above $250,000 after another quarter of crypto market downside.

title: Ripple teams with Kyobo on South Korea tokenized bond settlement
summary: Ripple and Kyobo Life are piloting tokenized government bond settlement as South Korea builds rules for token securities and digital asset payments.

title: Bitcoin ETFs post $412M in inflows as Goldman Sachs files for BTC ETF
summary: US-listed spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $411.5 million in inflows Tuesday as Goldman Sachs filed for a Bitcoin-linked ETF, lifting 2026 net flows back into positive territory.

title: SocGen brings MiCA-compliant USDCV dollar stablecoin to MetaMask
summary: Societe Generale-FORGE said MetaMask will add its MiCA-compliant USDCV stablecoin, extending distribution for one of Europe’s bank-backed digital dollars.

title: North Korean hackers used AI-enabled social engineering in Zerion attack
summary: It is the second long-term social-engineering attack this month, after the $280 million exploit of the Drift Protocol.

title: X rolls out smart cashtags in US, Canada in step toward ‘everything app’
summary: Tat Thang, a partner at the prediction platform Polymarket, suggests X is building a Web3 equivalent of the Chinese WeChat Pay citing its recent moves to scrub crypto bots.

title: Crypto users targeted in ‘elaborate’ scam using popular notes app
summary: Elastic Security Labs says a multi-step social engineering scam is aimed at those in crypto and finance, using a community plugin feature on a note-taking app to spread malicious device-controlling software.

title: Apple removes fake Ledger app that stole $9.5M from crypto investors
summary: Apple told Cointelegraph that the fake Ledger Live app was removed and that the developer was terminated from its app store.

title: Switzerland’s Crypto Valley funding rose 37% in 2025 as TON led deals
summary: Crypto Valley raised $728 million across 31 deals in 2025, outpacing global blockchain funding growth as a $400 million TON deal lifted totals.
